content:
The financial planning industry is evolving rapidly, with 85% of firms anticipating good revenue growth over the next 12 months. 

Yet, this promising outlook comes with challenges: mounting administrative demands, ever-changing compliance requirements, and the pressure to maintain impeccable client relationships. 

For financial planners striving to stay ahead, hiring a virtual assistant can be a game-changer.

Tips for Hiring and Managing Financial Planning Virtual Assistants

Financial planners often struggle to juggle client meetings, compliance processes, and day-to-day tasks. While determination and hard work are admirable, they can only go so far in such a demanding field. A virtual assistant can take over the administrative workload, allowing you to dedicate your energy to high-level strategic work.

Typical tasks a virtual assistant can manage include:

  • Scheduling client meetings and maintaining your calendar.
  • Helping to prepare Statements of Advice (SOAs) and other essential documents.
  • Managing CRMs like XPlan, AdviserLogic, and Midwinter.
  • Creating presentation templates and handouts for client meetings.
  • Staying on top of compliance updates and requirements.

With these responsibilities handled by a professional, you’ll not only save time but also improve the overall efficiency and organisation of your business. Virtual Office Angels provides virtual assistants who are well-versed in the nuances of financial planning, ensuring they integrate seamlessly into your operations.

How to Hire the Right Financial Planning Virtual Assistant

1. Clearly Define Your Needs

Start by identifying the specific tasks you want your assistant to handle. Are you looking for someone to prepare compliance documentation, manage client onboarding, or handle data entry and CRM updates? Clarifying your priorities can help you hire a virtual financial planning assistant with the proper skill set.

At Virtual Office Angels, we simplify this process by pairing you with assistants tailored to your requirements. Whether you need expertise in XPlan’s Risk Researcher or help managing your client pipeline, our assistants are equipped to meet your needs.

2. Prioritise Industry Experience

The financial planning sector has unique demands regarding compliance and data security. Hiring a VA with prior experience in the field ensures they’ll understand the intricacies of your business from day one.

Virtual Office Angels excels in providing VAs with financial planning expertise. Our candidates are not just familiar with your tools and processes—they’re adept at applying them effectively to support your business.

3. Emphasise Trust and Confidentiality

Given the sensitive nature of financial data, trust is critical. Your VA should understand confidentiality protocols and demonstrate a professional approach to handling client information.

With over a decade of experience, Virtual Office Angels has built a reputation for pairing clients with trustworthy professionals. Our rigorous vetting process ensures your assistant upholds the highest standards of confidentiality.

Managing Your Financial Planning Virtual Assistant

Once you’ve hired a VA, effective management is vital to maximising their potential. Here are some tips to ensure a productive working relationship:

1. Set Clear Expectations

Establish clear guidelines from the outset. Define the tasks your VA will handle, set deadlines, and communicate your preferred methods of reporting progress.

2. Leverage Communication Technology

Collaboration tools like Zoom, Slack, Skype, or Trello can be used to streamline communication and project management. These programs have the power to create a smooth workflow for your remote team in the long run.

3. Encourage Skill Development

The financial planning industry constantly evolves, with new tools, regulations, and client expectations emerging. Your virtual assistant must strive to stay informed and up-to-date with industry developments.

4. Provide Regular Feedback

Constructive feedback helps your assistant refine their approach and align more closely with your preferences. Open, regular communication fosters a collaborative partnership.
